title: Sage item record
description: A item record (ItemRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another item record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

uses+.description: Adds to "uses": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

uses-.description: Removes these from "uses" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

wearPerHit.description: Condition a weapon loses each time a blow it dealt lands; 0 = it never wears from use. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

wearWhenStruck.description: Condition a worn item (armour, a shield) loses each time its wearer is hurt; 0 = none. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

wornDamage.description: Damage multiplier at condition 0 (0 = a broken weapon does nothing); between it and full damage the scale is linear. At least 0. (float)

fullDamageAt.description: Condition at or above which it does full damage. Range: 0 to 1. (float)

breaks.description: What reaching condition 0 does: Unequip (it comes off until repaired), Remove (it is destroyed) or Keep (it stays, at the worn damage) (ItemBreak)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

questItem.description: A quest item: it cannot be dropped or sold, only given or taken by the story (issue #391) (bool, default false)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
